integrity: An algebraic-combinatorial proof supports the unrestricted finite-alphabet statement; exhaustive checking for alphabet sizes two through seven independently corroborates finite instances. No independent audit was carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exact error-free Parikh-vector prefix/suffix decks of lengths one through six only; no assertion for larger lengths, noisy observations or physical mass-collisions. Binary size-four fiber and binary threshold are prior results.
title: Universal length-six classification of prefix–suffix composition ambiguity
